name: Trust Authority AI
summary: A commercial 'Know Your Agent' service issuing and verifying portable trust evidence for agents: W3C verifiable credentials, runtime attestation, disclosure receipts and signed evidence packages via API/MCP.

overview.text: Trust Authority AI presents a commercial Know Your Agent evidence service with verifiable credentials, runtime attestations, disclosure receipts, trust scores and signed evidence packages through API and MCP. It explicitly calls evidence different from a verdict and does not absorb downstream liability. Its KYA levels range from DID resolution to private-authority compliance review; these are service categories, not an independently accepted safety standard. Homepage scores and sample-looking records are not authenticated customer outcomes. Competitor comparisons, quantum-safe language and legal-compliance notices are vendor claims, not independent tests or legal advice.

claims.quote: Know Your Agent. Issue, verify, and export portable trust evidence for autonomous agents: W3C verifiable credentials, runtime attestation
